About.label: About

story.p1: I'm Toluwalope Akinkunmi, a software developer focused on web and mobile. I like turning messy ideas into products that feel simple.
story.p2: I've built and scaled products used by hundreds of people — budgeting tools, ride booking, blogging platforms — and I've learned that quality is a habit, not a phase.
story.p3: Outside the editor I play games, binge series, read, and contribute to open source. I'm always up for meeting new people and learning from them.

coinsave.body: Designing, developing, managing and scaling a budgeting platform with 500+ users, while continuously improving performance and functionality.

cabify.body: Optimised performance for fast loads and smooth navigation, which lifted customer satisfaction and engagement.

communication.title: Clear communication
communication.body: Short updates, honest timelines and no jargon. You always know what's happening and why.

collaboration.title: Smart collaboration
collaboration.body: I work well with designers, PMs and other engineers — reviews, pairing and shared ownership.

adaptability.title: Easy adaptability
adaptability.body: New stack, new domain, changed scope — I pick things up quickly and adjust without drama.

time.title: Time management
time.body: I break work into small, shippable pieces and prioritise what moves the needle first.

problems.title: Problem solving
problems.body: I dig until I understand the real problem, then pick the simplest thing that solves it.

creativity.title: Creativity & innovation
creativity.body: Good products have a little delight in them. I look for the detail that makes people smile.

coinsave.title: Coinsave
coinsave.summary: Take control of your finances: track income and expenses, set budgets, get notified, and monitor bank transactions in one place.
coinsave.problem: Most people know they should budget but drop off after a week. Spreadsheets are tedious and banking apps only show what already happened.
coinsave.process: I designed a fast, low-friction flow for logging spending, built budgets with smart alerts, and connected bank transaction monitoring so the app does most of the work.
coinsave.outcome: Coinsave grew to more than 500 active users with over 70% engagement and an average rating of 4.5 out of 5.
coinsave.learnings: Retention is a product feature. Small touches — sensible defaults, timely nudges — mattered more than any big feature.

cabify.title: Cabify
cabify.summary: Hassle-free travel with easy booking, real-time updates and secure payments for rides in buses and cabs.
cabify.problem: Booking a ride meant juggling calls, cash and uncertainty about when the driver would actually show up.
cabify.process: I built the booking and tracking interfaces with a focus on performance, so the app loads fast and navigation feels smooth even on slow connections.
cabify.outcome: More than 500 active users, over 70% engagement and an average rating of 4.5 out of 5.
cabify.learnings: Perceived speed is real speed. Skeletons, optimistic updates and fewer round-trips changed how fast the app felt.

genz-blog.title: Gen-Z Blog
genz-blog.summary: A place to read and write articles on all kinds of topics — simple, minimal, and fully dark-mode friendly.
genz-blog.problem: Blogging platforms are either bloated or built for professionals. I wanted something that felt light and welcoming for every age group.
genz-blog.process: I built it with React, Next.js and Tailwind on the front, and Node.js with SQL behind it, keeping the writing flow distraction-free.
genz-blog.outcome: Over 100 active users reading and writing on the platform.
genz-blog.learnings: Minimal design is a lot of decisions. Every removed option made writing easier.

reciept.title: Reciept
reciept.summary: Create receipts for businesses and personal use, export them as PDFs and print on thermal printers — a digital and a paper copy at once.
reciept.problem: Small businesses waste ink and paper on receipts and rarely keep a reliable digital record.
reciept.process: Receipts are generated as PDFs sized for thermal printers, so one action gives you both a paper copy and a digital proof of purchase.
reciept.learnings: Printing is the hardest part of the web. Thermal printers have opinions.
